title: Baggage allowance: domestic flights
text: This allowance applies to flights within Australia. Checked baggage: Economy Lite fares do not include checked baggage, but a bag can be added online. Economy Classic and Economy Flex fares include 1 piece of checked baggage up to 23 kg. Business fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 32 kg each. Tidewater Rewards Gold and Platinum members receive 1 extra piece up to 23 kg on top of their fare allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and the total length, width and height of each checked bag must not exceed 158 cm. Cabin baggage: Economy passengers may bring 1 cabin bag up to 7 kg with maximum dimensions of 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm, plus 1 small personal item such as a handbag or laptop bag. Business passengers may bring 2 cabin bags up to 7 kg each plus a personal item. Mobility aids, a nappy bag for an infant, a coat and duty-free goods are allowed in addition. Cabin bags are weighed at check-in and may be checked in at the gate on full flights at no charge. If your itinerary includes both domestic and international flights on one ticket, the international allowance applies to the whole journey, including the domestic flights.

title: Baggage allowance: international flights
text: This allowance applies to flights between Australia and other countries. Checked baggage: Economy Lite fares include 1 piece of checked baggage up to 23 kg. Economy Classic and Economy Flex fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 23 kg each. Business fares include 2 pieces of checked baggage up to 32 kg each. Tidewater Rewards Gold and Platinum members receive 1 extra piece up to 23 kg on top of their fare allowance. No single bag may weigh more than 32 kg, and the total length, width and height of each checked bag must not exceed 158 cm. Cabin baggage: Economy passengers may bring 1 cabin bag up to 7 kg with maximum dimensions of 56 cm x 36 cm x 23 cm, plus 1 small personal item such as a handbag or laptop bag. Business passengers may bring 2 cabin bags up to 7 kg each plus a personal item. Some airports, including Singapore and Tokyo Narita, weigh cabin bags again at the gate. Liquids, aerosols and gels in cabin baggage must follow the security rules of the departure airport. When your journey includes a flight on a partner airline, the allowance of the airline operating the first international flight may apply, so check the allowance shown on your e-ticket receipt.

title: Extra baggage and sports equipment
text: Extra bags: an additional checked bag up to 23 kg costs AUD 75 on domestic flights and AUD 150 on international flights when bought online in Manage Booking up to 3 hours before departure. Bought at the airport, the same bag costs AUD 110 on domestic flights and AUD 220 on international flights. Overweight bags: a bag weighing more than 23 kg and up to 32 kg, on a fare whose allowance is 23 kg per piece, is charged AUD 60 on domestic flights and AUD 120 on international flights. Bags over 32 kg must be repacked or sent as freight. All prices are per bag, per flight. Sports equipment is counted as part of your normal checked allowance and is charged at the extra bag rates only if it takes you over that allowance. Surfboards: up to 3 boards may travel in one board bag, with a maximum length of 2.77 m and a maximum weight of 32 kg, and fins must be removed. Bicycles must be packed in a bike box or bag with the pedals removed and the handlebars turned. Golf bags may hold 1 set of clubs, 1 pair of shoes and balls. Sports equipment longer than 2.77 m or heavier than 32 kg cannot be carried on Coralwind Airways flights. Scuba tanks are carried only if empty and with the valve removed.

title: Check-in and boarding times
text: Online check-in opens 24 hours before domestic flights and 48 hours before international flights. It closes 30 minutes before domestic departure and 90 minutes before international departure. Airport check-in counters and bag drop close 30 minutes before domestic flights and 60 minutes before international flights. Boarding gates close 15 minutes before domestic departure and 40 minutes before international departure. Passengers who are not at the gate by these times may be offloaded and their bags removed. Early bag drop: at Brisbane International Airport, passengers on flights departing before 9 am may drop their bags at the Coralwind Airways counter between 6 pm and 9 pm the evening before, after checking in online. Early bag drop is not available at any other airport, or for passengers with infants, unaccompanied minors or onward flights on other airlines. Passengers must carry the passport used for booking on international flights, and photo ID on domestic flights if asked. Coralwind Airways recommends arriving 3 hours before international flights and 90 minutes before domestic flights. Kiosks at Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne airports can print boarding passes and bag tags.

title: Fare rules and change fees (effective 1 March 2025)
text: These rules apply to tickets issued from 1 March 2025. Economy Lite: changes are not permitted, and the fare is non-refundable except for government taxes, which are refunded on request. Economy Classic: date or flight changes cost AUD 99 on domestic flights and AUD 200 on international flights per passenger, plus any fare difference. Cancellation returns the fare as a travel credit minus AUD 100 on domestic flights or AUD 200 on international flights. Economy Flex: changes are free, plus any fare difference, and cancellation is refundable to the original payment method. Business: changes are free, plus any fare difference; cancellation is refundable to the original payment method minus AUD 300 on international flights. Change of mind: any fare may be cancelled for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase if the first flight departs at least 7 days after purchase. Changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the first affected flight; otherwise the ticket is treated as a no-show and the unused fare is forfeited, apart from refundable taxes. Changes made through the contact centre carry a service fee of AUD 25 per booking; changes made in Manage Booking have no service fee.

title: Fare rules and change fees (effective 1 September 2026)
text: These rules apply to tickets issued from 1 September 2026 and replace the rules effective 1 March 2025. Economy Lite: changes are not permitted, and the fare is non-refundable except for government taxes, which are refunded on request. Economy Classic: date or flight changes cost AUD 120 on domestic flights and AUD 250 on international flights per passenger, plus any fare difference. Cancellation returns the fare as a travel credit minus AUD 100 on domestic flights or AUD 200 on international flights. Economy Flex: changes are free, plus any fare difference, and cancellation is refundable to the original payment method. Business: changes are free, plus any fare difference; cancellation is refundable to the original payment method minus AUD 300 on international flights. Change of mind: the free cancellation window is now shorter. Any fare may be cancelled for a full refund only within 4 hours of purchase, and only if the first flight departs at least 7 days after purchase. After 4 hours the normal fare rules apply; there is no 24-hour free cancellation period. Changes and cancellations must be made before the scheduled departure of the first affected flight; otherwise the ticket is treated as a no-show and the unused fare is forfeited, apart from refundable taxes. Changes made through the contact centre carry a service fee of AUD 25 per booking; changes made in Manage Booking have no service fee.

title: Name corrections and ticket transfers
text: Name corrections: if a passenger's name has been misspelt, up to 3 characters can be corrected free of charge through the contact centre, as long as the corrected name matches the passenger's passport or photo ID. A change of surname after marriage, divorce or a legal name change is also made free of charge on sight of the supporting document. Ticket transfers: unlike many airlines, Coralwind Airways allows a ticket to be transferred to a different person on Economy Flex and Business fares. A transfer costs AUD 150 per ticket, can be made only once per ticket, and must be completed at least 72 hours before the first flight departs. The new passenger takes over the existing booking, seats and fare conditions; extras that are personal to the original passenger, such as points upgrades, are cancelled. Economy Lite and Economy Classic tickets cannot be transferred to another person; if the original passenger cannot travel, those tickets follow the normal cancellation rules. Transfers must be requested by the person who made the booking, through the contact centre, which is open from 6 am to 10 pm Brisbane time, seven days a week. For international flights the new passenger must hold the passport and any visas needed for the trip, and the transfer fee is not refunded if the new passenger is refused boarding for missing documents.

title: Travel credits and refunds
text: Travel credits are issued when an Economy Classic ticket is cancelled, when a passenger chooses credit instead of a refund after a disruption, and as a goodwill gesture. A Coralwind Airways travel credit is valid for 6 months from its issue date. This is shorter than the 12 months offered by many airlines, so please note the expiry date shown in your Tidewater Rewards profile or in the email confirming the credit. A travel credit must be used to make a new booking before it expires; the new flight itself may depart after the expiry date, as long as it departs within 12 months of the credit's issue date. Credits cannot be extended, are not transferable, and can only be used for bookings that include the passenger named on the credit. If the new booking costs less than the credit, the balance stays as a credit with the original expiry date. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash. Refunds to the original payment method, for refundable fares or cancelled flights, are processed within 10 business days; the time for the money to appear on your statement then depends on your bank. Refunds for bookings made through a travel agent are handled by that agent. Taxes on a non-refundable fare can be claimed for up to 12 months after the date of the unused flight.

title: Infants, children and Young Flyers
text: Infants are children under 2 years old. On flights scheduled to take less than 9 hours, an infant may travel on an adult's lap. Lap infants travel free on domestic flights and pay 10% of the adult fare on international flights. On flights scheduled to take 9 hours or longer, including Brisbane to Vancouver, Brisbane to Los Angeles and Brisbane to Tokyo, infants cannot travel on a lap and must have their own seat with an approved infant car seat, at 50% of the adult fare. This is because the long-haul aircraft used on these routes have no bassinet positions. On shorter international flights, bassinets can be requested for infants under 11 kg at seats in the bulkhead rows. Each adult may travel with only one lap infant. Children aged 2 to 11 pay the child fare and must have their own seat. Unaccompanied minors: children aged 5 to 11 travelling without an adult must use the Young Flyer service, which costs AUD 95 per child per flight on domestic flights and AUD 190 per child per flight on international flights. Children aged 12 to 15 may use the service on request at the same price. Children under 5 cannot travel without an adult aged 16 or older. The Young Flyer service is available on direct Coralwind Airways flights only and must be booked through the contact centre at least 48 hours before departure.

title: Special meals and assistance
text: Special meals: vegetarian, vegan, halal, kosher, gluten-free, diabetic, low-lactose and child meals can be ordered on all international flights and on domestic flights in Business. Special meals must be requested at least 36 hours before departure in Manage Booking or through the contact centre. Requests made later than 36 hours before departure cannot be met, because meals are loaded by our caterers in advance; a special meal cannot be ordered at check-in. Kosher meals need 72 hours' notice. Economy passengers on domestic flights receive a complimentary snack and drink, and the snack range always includes a vegetarian option. Wheelchair assistance: help through the airport and to your seat is free of charge and should be requested at least 48 hours before departure. Passengers bringing their own battery-powered wheelchair or mobility scooter must notify us at least 48 hours before departure; lithium batteries must not exceed 300 Wh, or two batteries of 160 Wh each. Mobility aids are carried free and do not count toward your baggage allowance. Passengers who need a portable oxygen concentrator must use an approved model and tell us at least 72 hours before departure. Assistance dogs travel free in the cabin on all flights with the required documents. Pets are carried only in the hold on domestic flights, through our approved pet transport partner, and are not accepted on international flights.

title: Delays, cancellations and disruption support
text: If your Coralwind Airways flight is delayed for reasons within our control, such as crew or engineering issues, we provide the following. For a delay of 2 hours or more, you receive a meal voucher of AUD 20 per passenger; for a delay of 4 hours or more, the voucher is AUD 40. If the delay is overnight and you are away from home, we provide hotel accommodation and transfers. Weather and air traffic control delays are outside our control and do not attract vouchers, although we will still rebook you. If we cancel your flight, or change its time by more than 2 hours, you can choose to be rebooked free of charge on the next available Coralwind Airways flight, take a travel credit, or receive a full refund to the original payment method. A refund request must be made within 28 days of the cancellation through Manage Booking or the contact centre; if no choice is made within 28 days, the booking is automatically converted into a travel credit. Disruption messages are sent by SMS and email. Passengers who prefer to travel on a different day within 7 days of a cancelled flight can move at no cost, subject to seats. Coralwind Airways does not pay fixed cash compensation for delays, but passengers may claim reasonable costs caused by a cancellation within our control by submitting receipts within 30 days.

title: Connections and minimum connection times
text: When all your flights are on one Coralwind Airways booking, your bags are checked through to your final destination and we are responsible for getting you there if a delay causes you to miss a connection. We will rebook you free of charge on the next available flight and, if you have to wait overnight, provide a hotel. Minimum connection times are the shortest connections we will sell on one booking. At Brisbane: domestic to domestic 40 minutes; international to domestic 90 minutes; domestic to international 75 minutes; international to international 60 minutes. At Sydney, international to domestic connections need 120 minutes because of the transfer between terminals. Separate bookings: if you book two flights on separate bookings, your bags are not checked through and a missed connection is normally your responsibility. Self-connect protection: if both separate bookings are on Coralwind Airways flights and you left at least 3 hours between the scheduled arrival and the next departure, we will rebook you free of charge on the next available flight if a delay to the first flight makes you miss the second. With less than 3 hours between them, standard change fees apply. Connections with partner airlines on separate bookings are never protected. When arriving from overseas into Brisbane, you must collect your bags and clear customs and biosecurity before re-checking them for a domestic flight.

title: Tidewater Rewards tiers, points and upgrades
text: Tidewater Rewards is the Coralwind Airways frequent flyer programme. Members earn points for spending and status credits for flying. Tiers are based on status credits earned in a membership year: Blue on joining, Silver at 250 status credits, Gold at 600 status credits, and Platinum at 1,200 status credits. Silver members get priority check-in and 1 lounge invitation per year. Gold members get lounge access with 1 guest when flying Coralwind Airways, priority boarding and 1 extra checked bag up to 23 kg. Platinum members get all Gold benefits plus 2 guests in the lounge and priority on waitlists. Points expiry: points expire 36 months after the end of the month in which they were earned. Flying or earning more does not extend existing points, unlike programmes where any account activity keeps the whole balance alive; the oldest points always expire first. Points upgrades: members can use points to request an upgrade to Business, but only on Economy Classic and Economy Flex fares; Economy Lite fares cannot be upgraded with points. Upgrade requests must be made at least 72 hours before departure and are confirmed or declined at the latest 24 hours before departure. If an upgrade is not confirmed, no points are deducted. An upgrade from Brisbane to Tokyo costs 30,000 points one way from Economy Flex and 40,000 points from Economy Classic.

title: Shoreline Lounge locations and access
text: Shoreline Lounges are open at the Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne domestic terminals and at Brisbane International Airport. Domestic lounges open from 4:30 am until the last Coralwind Airways departure; the Brisbane international lounge opens 3 hours before each international departure. Entry is allowed up to 3 hours before your flight and is not available on arrival. Who can enter: Business passengers on the day of travel; Tidewater Rewards Gold members with 1 guest and Platinum members with 2 guests when flying Coralwind Airways; and Silver members using a lounge invitation. Economy passengers without status can buy a lounge day pass for AUD 65 at domestic lounges or AUD 90 at the Brisbane international lounge. Day passes are sold in the app up to 1 hour before departure and at the lounge reception if there is space. Children under 2 enter free and children aged 2 to 11 pay half the day pass price. Business passengers on domestic flights may bring 1 guest only if the guest is also travelling that day. The lounges offer hot food, a bar from 11 am, showers at Brisbane international and free Wi-Fi. Dress standards apply, so no swimwear or bare feet.
